name: order_fungal_culture
description: Orders a fungal culture of clinical specimens to identify fungal pathogens including Candida, Aspergillus, Cryptococcus, dermatophytes, and endemic mycoses. Includes KOH preparation and may include fungal antigen testing.

specimen_source.description: Source of specimen (skin scraping, nail, hair, sputum, CSF, blood, tissue, BAL)

clinical_indication.description: Clinical reason for ordering fungal culture

include_antigen_testing.description: Whether to include fungal antigen/antibody testing (galactomannan, beta-glucan, cryptococcal antigen)

when_to_use: Suspected invasive fungal infection in immunocompromised patient
Chronic skin, nail, or hair infection (dermatophyte)

examples.query: Send BAL for fungal culture and galactomannan

args.clinical_indication: febrile neutropenic patient with pulmonary infiltrates
